features.name: General Journal batches
features.description: The ability to create and define batches for journal entries in Business Central. Batches can be set up operationally or per user for multiple users entering transactions.

features.name: Account name auto-filter in journal entry
features.description: When entering a journal entry, users can type the account name and the dropdown will automatically filter matching accounts, without needing to remember the account number.

features.name: Show more columns view for journal entries
features.description: An alternative view option in Business Central's general journal that displays journal entries in a grid format showing debit and credit amounts separately for multiple lines.

features.name: Single-line journal entry
features.description: The ability to enter a complete journal entry in a single line by specifying the account, amount, and offset account which will be automatically credited.

features.name: Excel integration for journal entries
features.description: Users can export journal entries to Excel, make mass changes or edits to large numbers of lines, and then publish the changes back into Business Central.
